sentences.text:
Date : 20-01-2023 Heard Mr. S Muktar, learned counsel for the accused and also heard Mr. R.J.
Baruah, learned Addl. PP, appearing for the State respondent, and Mr. I Ahmed, learned counsel for the informant.

This application under section 439 Cr.P.C., is preferred by accused, namely, Sultan Mamood, who has been languishing in jail hajot in connection with Latashil PS Case No.154/2022, under section 366 IPC added section 376, read with section 4 of POCSO Act, 22.11.2022, for grant of bail.

The above noted case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged by Fayzur Rahman, on 17.11.2022 to the effect that, on 17.11.2022 at about 8.00 AM in the morning he dropped his daughter Smti X at T.C. Girls School at Guwahati Club and since then she is missing and her mobile phone is switch off and later on he came to know that she is with one Sultan Mamood.

Mr. Muktar, the learned counsel for the accused submits that the accused is behind the bar for the last 59 days and there was love affairs between the accused and the victim girl and that the accused is ready to cooperate with the investigating agency and therefore, it is contended to allow this petition.

On the other hand, Mr. R.J. Baruah, learned Addl. PP has produced the case diary before this Court and submits that the investigation is almost completed and further, Mr. Baruah submits that Page No.# 3/3 since the date of birth of the victim is 28.06.2006, her age is 16 years and 6 months and therefore, he has objection in enlarging the accused on bail.
Joining with the learned Addl. PP, Mr. I Ahmed, learned counsel for the informant also opposed in allowing this petition.

Having heard the submission of learned Advocate for both the sides, I have carefully gone through the petition and the documents placed on record and also perused the case diary with the assistance of learned Addl. PP.
It appears that the investigation is almost completed and there remains to submit charge sheet only.

And in view of the materials available on record, specially the statement of the victim girl recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C., and also the length of detention this Court is of the view that a case for granting bail to the accused is made out and accordingly, it is provided that on furnishing a bond of Rs.25,000/-, with one surety of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge,
POCSO, Guwahati, the accused be enlarged on bail.
In terms of the above, the bail application stands disposed of.
The case diary be returned.
